verdict.rationale: Tavily is fundamentally an API-first product with extensive documented REST endpoints (search, extract, crawl, map, research) plus official Python/JS SDKs, rate-limit docs, usage/logs endpoints, and keyless trial mode — all clearly aimed at programmatic/AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard paths), which would round out full API-native tooling.
